metadata.description: A minimal DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that registers a greet tool. Everything in dsh is a plugin; this repository shows the smallest complete bundle you can publish and install.
metadata.name: dsh-greet

A minimal DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that registers a `greet` tool. Everything in dsh is a plugin
; this repository shows the smallest complete bundle you can publish and install.

- Registers a `greet` tool callable by the agent: `greet(name)` → `Hello, <name>!`
- No build step:
plain JavaScript, installs straight from GitHub.
